parsed.title: Premium Insights Unlock
parsed.oneLiner: Unlock exclusive in-depth news analysis by playing a quick game.

newMechanic.name: Premium Insights
newMechanic.description: Exclusive investigative deep-dive articles added as an additive tier on top of the complete existing free news catalog, with zero free content removed.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: To provide high-quality gated content as a new ad-supported product tier, creating a value-exchange for non-paying users without harming trust.

parsed.trigger: Returning user (session 2+) taps an article in the feed marked 'Premium Insight'.

offer.title: Unlock Premium Insight
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to access this in-depth investigative article.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Content access is rate-limited to 3 articles per day. All existing free news articles remain fully accessible without ads or restrictions; this introduces purely additive premium content.
risks: Low ad fill rate in certain geographies.
Potential user friction if premium labels are not clearly distinguished from free articles.

evidence.quote: Tiffani Thiessen says a former resident still live

newScreens.change: Modal to unlock premium content for the user.

newElements.change: Play button to initiate rewarded ad.

callouts.text: A new 'Premium' tag identifies exclusive in-depth insights.
